entries.title: First release
notes: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream runs natively on iPhone and iPad, built on your own game dump.
Import a save from Ryujinx, yuzu and its forks, or a Checkpoint / JKSV backup (Settings > Islands > Import a save).
Respect silent mode (Settings > Feedback): off by default, so the game plays even with the phone on silent.
Send feedback and crash reports from the launcher; reports include the game log, never your saves.
